description: Active official severe weather warnings as JSON, no API key: all US National Weather Service alerts (tornado, flood, winter storm, heat, fire weather, marine) and all German DWD warnings in one CAP-style schema: event, severity, urgency, certainty, onset, expires, headline, instructions, area and states. Filter by state, severity or event, or check up to 25 lat,lon points per call. Monitor mode returns only new warnings. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/weather-alerts-api.

country.description: For area: US (National Weather Service: states, territories, coastal waters) or DE (Germany, Deutscher Wetterdienst).

events.description: Only warnings whose event or headline contains one of these words, e.g. tornado, flood, winter, frost, Gewitter.

includeGeometry.description: Add the warning polygon (GeoJSON) when the source has one (NWS storm-based warnings).

includeTests.description: Also return NWS test/keep-alive messages (normally hidden).

limit.description: Maximum rows returned, most severe first. Between 1 and 5000.

locations.description: For point: up to 25 places as 'lat,lon', e.g. 29.7604,-95.3698. A place with no warning returns one row with activeAlerts 0.

minSeverity.description: Only warnings at this level or higher (CAP severity: Minor < Moderate < Severe < Extreme). Empty = all.

mode.description: area = every active warning in a country (US or DE), optionally only some states; point = warnings that cover one or more lat,lon locations (US and Germany).

states.description: For area: optional state filter. US: TX, FL or Texas; Germany: BY, NW or Bavaria. Empty = whole country.

name: weather_alerts_api
title: Weather Alerts API - NWS & DWD Severe Warnings, No Key
